goal: Bring the real GB notification services (the live-animals journey, its dashboard, templates and address book) up to Design Release 2.1 of the GB notification service prototype, so that wherever a real service differs from Design Release 2.1 it changes to match it, except where a DR1 judgement on that same difference, or a real constraint the prototype cannot express (persistence, validation, authentication, cross-service behaviour), overrides it.
reposWhy: Design Release 2.1 covers the live-animals notification journey (animals frontend and backend), the notifications dashboard and address book (owned by the INS front door, its read model in ins-backend, and the address-book system of record), and the reference lists the journey reads (reference-data); the tests repo holds every service's end-to-end suite.
themes: Group increments into themes drawn from the evidence, with boundaries set by the code each theme touches (repo and folder), so each theme can be built in parallel on a separate machine without pull requests that conflict with another theme's.

sources.role: the owner's decisions: outranks every other source. It sets how the rest are weighed: the prototype wins by default over what the real services do today; only a DR1 judgement on the same difference, or a real constraint the prototype cannot express (persistence, validation, authentication, cross-service behaviour), overrides it.

sources.scope: whole file: the standing rulings, the groups blocked by ruling and why, and any other judgement it records (copied from commit 6688fd8e on origin/feat/parity-report-triage-view)
sources.role: DR1 judgements only. Never a source of requirements on its own. Used only where the real frontend and the prototype clash: where DR1 already judged that same difference, the judgement wins and its row is cited.

sources.scope: every row's judgement on a difference between the real frontend and the prototype: rows whose status is rejected, dropped, blocked or deferred, with the reason; and every RULING or decision recorded in any row's notes, openQuestions or decision field, whatever its status. A done row is a judgement only where its notes record a choice that departs from the prototype. Cite each by row id (inc-NNN). Copied from commit 6688fd8e on origin/feat/parity-report-triage-view.
sources.role: DR1 judgements only. Never a source of requirements on its own. Used only where the real frontend and the prototype clash: where DR1 already judged that same difference, the judgement wins and its row is cited.

sources.scope: Design Release 2.1 only, at commit 04a073b (read with git show 04a073b:<path> if the checkout has moved): app/lib/version-mount.js and app/lib/design-release-2.1-version.js (how /design-release-2.1 mirrors the root routes and overrides views), every view in app/views/design-release-2.1/, the root views and partials those pages fall back to where DR2.1 has no override, the handlers and validation in app/routes.js reached under /design-release-2.1, and app/data/ lists those pages read.
